artifact_reasoning: The image suffers from notable structural and textural artifacts. The pink ring exhibits a plastic-like texture inconsistent with wax, and its fusion with the flame and candle body shows boundary softness (fusion artifact). The wax melting pattern defies typical gravity-driven viscosity, appearing artificially sculpted. While the overall lighting and composition are high quality, these physical inconsistencies prevent a high artifact score.
